answer: Anchor each agent to one funded Lightning channel, a live vertex in the payment graph. First, the agent opens a channel locking 0.01 BTC and registers the channel ID. Second, it routes one payment weekly for 30 days, proving control. Third, graph analysis flags channels sharing funding UTXOs, so a clone army betrays itself. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 100 BTC, about $9,000,000, plus $250,000 in bonds and 30 days of upkeep, while the tide of cheap fakes cannot afford the summit. A harbor admitting only ships with a paid berth stays open to real agents, closed to ghosts.
